name: What, So What, Now What?
deliverable: Ladder of inference progression: observations, interpretations, actions

steps.text: List only what happened, one observation per note, with no interpretation or judgment.
Ask what patterns the observations carry, and record the different readings side by side.
Name next actions, owners, and a check-in date.

failure: The room jumps to opinions and fixes, so the group argues about interpretations without agreeing on facts.
intervention: Point at the observations and ask what we actually saw before anyone explains it; facts first.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
